label: Endocrine and neurochemical
definition: Measured hormones neuropeptides neurotransmitters or receptor expression in a defined tissue or biological matrix

label: Autonomic and cardiovascular
definition: Physiological indicators such as heart rate heart rate variability blood pressure or species-appropriate conductance

label: Neural activity
definition: Electrophysiological hemodynamic or immediate-early-gene measures linked to neural processing

label: Respiratory and somatic
definition: Respiration dynamics and physiological motor patterns rather than assumed signaling

label: Thermal and metabolic
definition: Body temperature or energy use under defined measurement conditions

label: Immune and biochemical
definition: Inflammatory biochemical or other physiological markers linked to a measured context

label: Molecular and evolutionary
definition: Genes peptides receptor families sequence homology and expression used for mechanistic comparisons
